_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack (LP.6). Genre-authentic DNA for the on-device 'Make it new' generator (LoopStarMaterialEngine). The Swift binary is a SKELETON (RULE #1): it ships a clamped tempo-heuristic fallback and reads THIS file at runtime for the real genre feel. Zero-rebuild to tune. Schema owner: LoopStarGenrePack.swift. Encoded from docs/idiom-research/genre-house-edm.md section C. Companion phrase pack: phrases/trance/.
name: Trance
blurb: Uplifting trance: a four-on-the-floor 909 pulse, a rolling offbeat-16th synth bass on the root, supersaw pads pumping against the kick, and a soaring minor-key saw lead.

flavors.label: Uplifting Anthem
flavors.blurb: The signature: i, bVI, bIII, bVII a bar apart, supersaw pads pumping against every kick.

flavors.label: Progressive Trance
flavors.blurb: Two chords stretched over eight bars - deeper, more patient, the pads doing the moving.

flavors.label: Acid Tunnel
flavors.blurb: Goa-style one-chord drive: no changes at all, just the root and the 303 doing the work.

flavors.label: Dream Trance
flavors.blurb: The wistful 90s piano side - chords held whole, falling through bIII and bVII.

flavors.label: Hard Trance
flavors.blurb: Plain minor triads punched out as hoover stabs, quantised to the millisecond.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Trance lives in natural minor; a major key reads as a genre fail. The lift comes from the bVI, bIII and bVII majors inside the minor loop, one chord per bar over eight or sixteen. Plain triads with an added ninth, not sevenths, with sus2 or sus4 at the turn. No V-i cadence: the loop climbs, never resolves.
